items.hook: Las muertas is a 1977 novel by Mexican author Jorge Ibargüengoitia, originally published in Spanish by Joaquín Mortiz in Mexico City.
items.body: Asa Zatz's English translation The Dead Girls was first published in 1982 by Chatto & Windus in the United Kingdom and by Avon Books in the United States and was reprinted by Picador Classics in 2018. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Abdulhamid Sulaymon zoda Yunusov, most commonly known by his penname Choʻlpon, was an Uzbek poet, playwright, novelist, and literary translator.
items.body: Choʻlpon was one of Central Asia's most popular poets during the first half of the 20th century. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
